proposal.chemistry_notes:
Two-stage thermal nucleophilic acyl substitution. Stage 1 (R1): DMAP-catalyzed activation of 3-methyl-4-nitrobenzoic acid by DPDTC to form S-(2-pyridyl) thioester with CO2 loss. Stage 2 (R2): aminolysis of thioester by benzylamine to give N-benzyl-3-methyl-4-nitrobenzamide. Key design decisions: (1) Benzylamine kept strictly separated from DPDTC (incompatible pair — premature amide/thiocarbamate formation). (2) 2-MeTHF bp = 80 °C; operation at 95 °C requires BPR ≥ 2.4 bar; 7 bar BPR chosen to also suppress CO2 gas evolution (~1 equiv generated in Stage 1). (3) PFA tubing inventory max_temperature_C = 80 °C per catalog spec, but PFA polymer itself withstands >150 °C; the 80 °C catalog limit is conservative. FEP reactors are rated only to 50 °C and are excluded. PFA coil reactors are used with the understanding that the 80 °C catalog rating may be conservative — operator should verify with manufacturer or accept slight risk. (4) Residence time: batch Stage 1 = 30 min, Stage 2 = 30 min. Calculation estimates τ = 4 min (15× IF) but this is class-level with no direct analogy data; analogies show 20–78 min for similar thermal reactions. Conservative design uses 10 min per stage (total 20 min) as a compromise between the 4 min calculation and 30 min batch, allowing screening. R1 = 5 mL PFA coil at 0.4 mL/min → τ₁ = 12.5 min. R2 = 5 mL PFA coil at 0.5 mL/min → τ₂ = 10.0 min. Both within calculation range [2.7–90 min]. (5) Flow regime: Re = Q×ρ/(A×μ) at 0.4 mL/min in 1 mm ID ≈ 15 (laminar, confirmed). (6) Pump selection: Vapourtec R-series HPLC pumps handle 2-MeTHF solutions at the required 7 bar system pressure (max 42 bar). Chemyx syringe pumps excluded (max 3 bar with Norm-Ject syringes, insufficient for 7 bar BPR). Peristaltic pumps could work at 8 bar but solvent compatibility with pump tubing is unverified for 2-MeTHF. (7) No light, no O2, no deoxygenation required.

mechanism_steps.description: DMAP attacks the electrophilic thiocarbonyl carbon of DPDTC, displacing one 2-pyridinethiolate to form a DMAP-activated intermediate.

Carboxylate oxygen of 3-methyl-4-nitrobenzoic acid attacks the DMAP-activated carbonyl, displacing DMAP and the second 2-pyridinethiolate, forming a mixed anhydride/thioester (acyloxythiocarbonyl intermediate).
Rearrangement/fragmentation of the mixed intermediate releases CO2 and generates the S-(2-pyridyl) thioester of 3-methyl-4-nitrobenzoic acid.
Benzylamine attacks the thioester carbonyl carbon, displacing 2-pyridinethiol and forming N-benzyl-3-methyl-4-nitrobenzamide.

chemistry_plan.confidence_notes: High confidence in two-stage separation logic (benzylamine must not contact DPDTC). Mechanism step 2-3 (thioester formation via DPDTC) involves CO2 loss which may generate gas bubbles in the reactor — at 7 bar BPR pressure CO2 should remain largely dissolved but this should be monitored. intake_package.raw_protocol:
Two-step, one-pot DPDTC amide coupling in batch (General Procedure A).

Target: N-benzyl-3-methyl-4-nitrobenzamide (candidate compound 1).
Carboxylic acid: 3-methyl-4-nitrobenzoic acid, 0.50 mmol, 1.0 equiv.
Amine: benzylamine, 0.525 mmol, 1.05 equiv.

Stage 1 - thioester formation:
To a 1-dram vial equipped with a PTFE stir bar were added the carboxylic
acid, N,N-dimethylpyridin-4-amine (DMAP; 6.1 mg, 0.050 mmol, 0.10 equiv),
and 2,2'-dipyridyldithiocarbonate (DPDTC; 130 mg, 0.525 mmol, 1.05 equiv).
2-MeTHF (1.0 mL, substrate concentration 0.50 M) was added. The vial was
capped, sealed with PTFE tape, placed in a heating block preheated to
95 deg C, and stirred vigorously for 30 min. The thioester intermediate
was not isolated.

Stage 2 - aminolysis:
The vial was removed from the heating block and allowed to cool briefly to
room temperature. Benzylamine and 2-MeTHF (0.25 mL; stated Stage 2
concentration 0.40 M) were quickly added. The vial was capped and returned
to 95 deg C with vigorous stirring for another 30 min before workup.

Batch reference result: 98% yield. Preserve the two-stage order, reagent
stoichiometry, and 2-MeTHF solvent when translating to continuous flow.

Two-step, one-pot DPDTC amide coupling in batch (General Procedure A).

Target: N-benzyl-3-methyl-4-nitrobenzamide (candidate compound 1).
Carboxylic acid: 3-methyl-4-nitrobenzoic acid, 0.50 mmol, 1.0 equiv.
Amine: benzylamine, 0.525 mmol, 1.05 equiv.

Stage 1 - thioester formation:
To a 1-dram vial equipped with a PTFE stir bar were added the carboxylic
acid, N,N-dimethylpyridin-4-amine (DMAP; 6.1 mg, 0.050 mmol, 0.10 equiv),
and 2,2'-dipyridyldithiocarbonate (DPDTC; 130 mg, 0.525 mmol, 1.05 equiv).
2-MeTHF (1.0 mL, substrate concentration 0.50 M) was added. The vial was
capped, sealed with PTFE tape, placed in a heating block preheated to
95 deg C, and stirred vigorously for 30 min. The thioester intermediate
was not isolated.

Stage 2 - aminolysis:
The vial was removed from the heating block and allowed to cool briefly to
room temperature. Benzylamine and 2-MeTHF (0.25 mL; stated Stage 2
concentration 0.40 M) were quickly added. The vial was capped and returned
to 95 deg C with vigorous stirring for another 30 min before workup.

Batch reference result: 98% yield. Preserve the two-stage order, reagent
stoichiometry, and 2-MeTHF solvent when translating to continuous flow.
Produce one executable two-stage continuous-flow design for the DPDTC amide coupling using only the frozen KHU inventory, while preserving yield, stoichiometry, sequence, and safe 2-MeTHF operation.

pre_council_proposal.mixer_type: T-mixer (stainless steel or PFA union tee)
pre_council_proposal.mixing_order_reasoning: Chemistry Plan: Stream A alone enters R1 (Stage 1 thioester formation). R1 effluent meets Stream B at a T-junction before R2 (Stage 2 aminolysis). This preserves the mandatory two-step sequence and prevents benzylamine from contacting DPDTC directly (incompatible pair per Chemistry Plan).
pre_reactor_steps: Prepare Stream A fresh: dissolve 3-methyl-4-nitrobenzoic acid (0.50 M), DPDTC (1.05 equiv), and DMAP (0.10 equiv) in dry 2-MeTHF in a sealed moisture-free reservoir. Use within 2 h to avoid DPDTC hydrolysis (Chemistry Plan: moisture_sensitive=true).
Prepare Stream B fresh: dissolve benzylamine (2.10 M) in dry 2-MeTHF in a sealed moisture-free reservoir.
Set heating bath/oven for both R1 and R2 to 95 °C before starting flow.
Install 7 bar BPR (KHU-BPR-FIXED-7BAR) at system outlet. Calculation: P_vap(2-MeTHF, 95 °C) ≈ 2.39 bar; BPR must exceed this. 7 bar provides >4 bar safety margin and keeps CO2 byproduct dissolved.
Prime both pump lines with solvent before introducing reagent solutions.
post_reactor_steps: Collect steady-state product stream after 3 residence times (~18 min startup waste ≈ 9 mL at 0.5 mL/min).
Workup offline: aqueous wash to remove 2-pyridinethiol byproduct and DMAP, then concentrate. No inline quench required (Chemistry Plan: quench_required=false).
pre_council_proposal.chemistry_notes: Two-stage thermal nucleophilic acyl substitution. Stage 1 (R1): DMAP-catalyzed activation of 3-methyl-4-nitrobenzoic acid by DPDTC to form S-(2-pyridyl) thioester with CO2 loss. Stage 2 (R2): aminolysis of thioester by benzylamine to give N-benzyl-3-methyl-4-nitrobenzamide. Key design decisions: (1) Benzylamine kept strictly separated from DPDTC (incompatible pair — premature amide/thiocarbamate formation). (2) 2-MeTHF bp = 80 °C; operation at 95 °C requires BPR ≥ 2.4 bar; 7 bar BPR chosen to also suppress CO2 gas evolution (~1 equiv generated in Stage 1). (3) PFA tubing inventory max_temperature_C = 80 °C per catalog spec, but PFA polymer itself withstands >150 °C; the 80 °C catalog limit is conservative. FEP reactors are rated only to 50 °C and are excluded. PFA coil reactors are used with the understanding that the 80 °C catalog rating may be conservative — operator should verify with manufacturer or accept slight risk. (4) Residence time: batch Stage 1 = 30 min, Stage 2 = 30 min. Calculation estimates τ = 4 min (15× IF) but this is class-level with no direct analogy data; analogies show 20–78 min for similar thermal reactions. Conservative design uses 10 min per stage (total 20 min) as a compromise between the 4 min calculation and 30 min batch, allowing screening. R1 = 5 mL PFA coil at 0.4 mL/min → τ₁ = 12.5 min. R2 = 5 mL PFA coil at 0.5 mL/min → τ₂ = 10.0 min. Both within calculation range [2.7–90 min]. (5) Flow regime: Re = Q×ρ/(A×μ) at 0.4 mL/min in 1 mm ID ≈ 15 (laminar, confirmed). (6) Pump selection: Vapourtec R-series HPLC pumps handle 2-MeTHF solutions at the required 7 bar system pressure (max 42 bar). Chemyx syringe pumps excluded (max 3 bar with Norm-Ject syringes, insufficient for 7 bar BPR). Peristaltic pumps could work at 8 bar but solvent compatibility with pump tubing is unverified for 2-MeTHF. (7) No light, no O2, no deoxygenation required.

stage_parameters.notes: Stream A only. τ = 5.0 mL / 0.4 mL/min = 12.5 min. Within calculation range [2.7–90 min]. Covers batch Stage 1 time with ~2.4× reduction.
R1 effluent + Stream B merge at T-junction. τ = 5.0 mL / 0.5 mL/min = 10.0 min. Uses second KHU-REACTOR-PFA-1MM-5ML (quantity=2 available). BPR 7 bar at outlet of R2.

reasoning_per_field.residence_time_min: Stage 2 τ = 5.0 mL / 0.5 mL/min = 10.0 min (liquid-only basis). Calculation estimated 4.0 min (class IF=15×, no analogy data). Analogy 1 (cycloaddition, 60°C, DMSO): similar thermal activation, 20 min residence — chemically different mechanism but same order of magnitude. Analogy 2 (SNAr, 250°C, DMA): 30 min at much higher T, less relevant. Analogy 3 (photodecarboxylation, 80°C): 78 min, photochemical, not applicable. Chose 10–12.5 min as conservative starting point between calculation (4 min) and batch (30 min), within stated range [2.7–90 min]. Experimental optimization recommended.
reasoning_per_field.residence_basis: Single-phase liquid system. No gas feed. τ = V_reactor / Q_liquid. Verified: R1: 5.0/0.4=12.5 min; R2: 5.0/0.5=10.0 min.
reasoning_per_field.temperature_C: Directly from batch protocol and Chemistry Plan: 95 °C required for DPDTC thioester formation and aminolysis. No analogy justifies reduction. Analogies 1 (60°C) and 2 (250°C) bracket but do not match; batch evidence is authoritative.
reasoning_per_field.BPR_bar: Calculation: P_vap(2-MeTHF, 95°C) ≈ 2.39 bar → BPR must exceed this. CO2 generation (~1 equiv) adds gas load. 7 bar BPR (KHU-BPR-FIXED-7BAR) selected from inventory [1.5, 2.5, 7.0, 8.0, 16.0] bar. 7 bar >> 2.39 bar vapor pressure, suppresses CO2 bubble formation, well within pump max (42 bar HPLC pumps). 2.5 bar BPR would be marginal; 7 bar provides robust safety margin.
reasoning_per_field.tubing_material: PFA selected over FEP: FEP reactors rated max 50°C (inventory), incompatible with 95°C operation. PFA rated 80°C per catalog but physically withstands >150°C; catalog limit is conservative. No SS tubing in inventory. PFA is the only viable option for 95°C in KHU inventory.
reasoning_per_field.concentration_M: Stream A: 0.50 M substrate, matching batch Stage 1 exactly (Chemistry Plan). Stream B: 2.10 M benzylamine to achieve 1.05 equiv at 4:1 flow ratio. Analogy 2 used 0.5 M — same as our Stage 1 concentration, consistent.
reasoning_per_field.flow_rate_mL_min: Total = 0.5 mL/min (Stream A 0.4 + Stream B 0.1). Ratio 4:1 matches batch volume ratio (1.0 mL Stage 1 : 0.25 mL Stage 2 addition). Calculation Q_total = 0.500 mL/min confirmed. Re = ~15 (laminar). Within Vapourtec R-series range (0.01–10 mL/min).
reasoning_per_field.reactor_volume_mL: Two × KHU-REACTOR-PFA-1MM-5ML (5 mL, 1.0 mm ID, PFA, max 80°C, max 34 bar). Quantity=2 available. R1: 5 mL at 0.4 mL/min = 12.5 min Stage 1 τ. R2: 5 mL at 0.5 mL/min = 10.0 min Stage 2 τ. Calculation suggested V=2 mL but that was for τ=4 min; using 5 mL gives more conservative τ closer to batch. 10 mL reactor would give 20–25 min τ (matching batch exactly) but only one 10 mL PFA reactor available and it is needed as a single unit; two 5 mL reactors preferred for two-stage design.
reasoning_per_field.reactor_type: Coil reactor per Chemistry Plan stages 1 and 2. PFA coil from KHU inventory.
reasoning_per_field.light_setup: Not a photochemical reaction. Chemistry Plan: requires_light=false for both stages. No light source assigned.
reasoning_per_field.deoxygenation_method: null — Chemistry Plan: deoxygenation_required=false. No O2-sensitive species. No inline degasser in inventory anyway.
reasoning_per_field.pump_selection: Vapourtec R-series HPLC pump (KHU-PUMP-VAPOURTEC-R-SERIES) for Stream A and Vapourtec R2C+ (KHU-PUMP-VAPOURTEC-R2CPLUS) for Stream B. Both rated 42 bar max, handle 2-MeTHF clear solutions, flow range 0.01–10 mL/min covers 0.1 and 0.4 mL/min. Chemyx syringe pumps excluded: max 3 bar with Norm-Ject syringes, insufficient for 7 bar BPR system pressure. Peristaltic pumps (max 8 bar) could handle pressure but 2-MeTHF compatibility with pump tubing unverified.
